title: Preserve the abelian-scheme bundle and fibre dimension under a quotient
statement: Let S be a universe-zero commutative ring, J an ideal of S, A a universe-zero scheme, and f : A → Spec S. Assume AbelianSchemePropertyBundle S f and that topologicalKrullDim of the topological fibre f⁻¹({s}) is 2 for every s ∈ Spec S. Put β = Spec(Ideal.Quotient.mk J) and p = pullback.snd f β. Then AbelianSchemePropertyBundle (S/J) p holds, and every topological fibre of p has topological Krull dimension 2. There are no Noetherian, nontriviality, or nilpotence assumptions.
lean_statement: ∀ (S : Type) [CommRing S] (J : Ideal S) (A : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{0}) (f : Quiver.Hom A (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of S))), GoodReductionJacobian.AbelianSchemePropertyBundle S f → (∀ s : ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of S)), topologicalKrullDim ↥(f.base ⁻¹' {s}) = 2) → let β := AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)); let p := CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.snd f β; GoodReductionJacobian.AbelianSchemePropertyBundle (S ⧸ J) p ∧ (∀ t : ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of (S ⧸ J))), topologicalKrullDim ↥(p.base ⁻¹' {t}) = 2)
